uutiset.t: Xi Probes Shanghai Boss, Widening Political Shakeup
uutiset.s: China has opened an investigation into Chen Jining, a member of the country's elite Politburo and the party chief of Shanghai, for suspected serious violations of law and discipline. Bloomberg Economics' Neil Thomas has the context. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Dangote Refinery Set to Become Africa’s Biggest Listed Company
uutiset.s: Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals FZE will rank as the biggest company with a primary listing in Africa once it makes its trading debut in Lagos, far exceeding the size of the next-largest business on the continent.

uutiset.t: Metals Mixed After Major Selloff as Traders Await US Inflation
uutiset.s: Copper ticked higher and aluminum steadied after a major selloff across metals on Tuesday, as traders awaited US inflation data that will feed into the Federal Reserve’s next decision on interest rates.

uutiset.t: Japan’s 40-Year Bond Sale Draws Weaker Demand on Risk Off Mood
uutiset.s: Japan’s 40-year government bond auction on Wednesday drew weaker demand as global risk-off sentiment weighed on investor appetite.

uutiset.t: Starbucks Is Said to Engage Banks for Sale of Japan Business
uutiset.s: Starbucks Corp. has tapped advisers to prepare for a potential sale of its Japan business for several billion dollars, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Huang Boost Fades Quickly as AI Fears Sink TSMC, SK Hynix Shares
uutiset.s: Asian stock market enthusiasm over the resurrection of Jensen Huang’s career evaporated Wednesday as investors refocused on worries around the global AI trade.

uutiset.t: India’s Anti-AI Stock Trade Confronts Rich Valuations, Global Tariff Risks
uutiset.s: Meanwhile, a cash crunch in India’s banking system is forcing lenders to borrow at higher costs.

uutiset.t: Rakuten Credit Risk Surges After Yen Bond Offering Scrapped
uutiset.s: Rakuten Group Inc.’s credit risk surged by the most since April 2025 after the company scrapped plans to raise about ¥150 billion ($942 million) in the bond market.

uutiset.t: India Pension Funds Pivot to Bonds as Equity Exposure Nears Cap
uutiset.s: India’s biggest pension funds are directing more of their inflows to government bonds as they near a regulatory threshold on equity investments, just as local stocks rebound from a bruising selloff.

uutiset.t: Australia’s Hot Inflation Vindicates RBA’s Hawkish Policy Stance
uutiset.s: Australia’s core inflation unexpectedly accelerated in October, highlighting persistent price pressures in the economy and vindicating Reserve Bank officials’ hawkish commentary.

uutiset.t: HDBank Turns to Global Investors With Bonds, Loan to Fund Growth in Vietnam
uutiset.s: Ho Chi Minh City Development JSC Bank is planning to both sell global bonds and borrow via the syndicated loan market, turning to overseas investors to meet rising credit demand in an economy chasing ambitious growth goals.

uutiset.t: Gold Holds Decline as US Tariff Plans Reinforce Rate-Hike Bets
uutiset.s: Gold held a decline, after the White House’s latest tariff plans drove equities lower and reinforced expectations for an interest-rate hike by the Federal Reserve.

uutiset.t: RBA’s Jacobs Says Financial Conditions ‘Restrictive’ After Hikes
uutiset.s: Australia’s financial conditions are “clearly restrictive” following five interest-rate increases this year, a senior Reserve Bank official said, while also noting the difficulty of determining the extent.

uutiset.t: US Readies Tariff Hike on China, EU Goods
uutiset.s: The US is set to announce plans to raise tariffs on goods from China, the European Union and more than a dozen other economies, according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg’s Derek Wallbank has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Butterball CEO on Thanksgiving Dinner Outlook
uutiset.s: Jay Jandrain, Butterball CEO, says U.S. turkey production is slightly higher than last year and holiday turkey prices are broadly consistent with prior years.
